doc: The user says what they want done; the planning chat (the mock Claude, no repository) answers with a drgnx-proposal block among prose. The hub checks it and proposes the job: say-proposal names it, the job is proposed with a proposal card whose title is the hub's (not the block's), its plan is a graph plan with the two tasks, the named profile is the task's, the budget and gate are the block's, and no worker runs: only the planning session. Pattern B: a virtual clock; each expectation waits on an event or an answer the hub sends after the fact it checks.

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/repo && cd $ROOT/repo && git init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q --allow-empty -m init

text:
say Here is the plan.
say ```drgnx-proposal
say {"title": "Settings review", "tasks": [{"n": 1, "title": "Read the settings", "role": "review", "profile": "mock-claude", "deps": [], "body": "Read the settings code."}, {"n": 2, "title": "Fix them", "role": "implement", "deps": [1], "body": "Fix what the review found."}], "budget": [{"amount": 20, "unit": "usd"}], "gate": "review"}
say ```

params.text: review the settings code, then fix what it finds

contains: review the settings code, then fix what it finds

sql: select count(*) from card where job = '$job' and kind = 'proposal' and state = 'open' and title like '%approve to start' and title not like '%Settings review%'
select count(*) from job where id = '$job' and plan like 'plan:%' and repo like '%/repo/'
select n, role from jtask where job = '$job' order by n
select json_extract(data, '$.profiles."' || id || '#1"'), json_extract(data, '$.profiles."' || id || '#2"'), json_extract(data, '$.gate') from job where id = '$job'
